title: MID PENN BANCORP INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Mid Penn Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 financial results and two corporate actions: (1) extension and expansion of its treasury stock repurchase program by an additional $50 million through April 30, 2027, and (2) declaration of a quarterly cash dividend of $0.22 per share payable May 15, 2026.
key_points: Board approved renewal of stock repurchase program through April 30, 2027
Program increased by up to $50 million additional authorization for future open market or negotiated repurchases
Repurchases to be conducted per SEC Rule 10b-18 and may be executed via Rule 10b5-1 trading plans
Board declared quarterly cash dividend of $0.22 per common share
Dividend payable May 15, 2026 to shareholders of record as of May 4, 2026
Q1 2026 financial results discussed in accompanying press release (Exhibit 99.1)
